name: chat-image-bridge
description: Queue image jobs from Codex and fulfill them through a local ChatGPT Web browser bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Generate project images through ChatGPT Web.
interface.longDescription: Queues text-to-image jobs from Codex, lets a local browser extension fulfill them in ChatGPT Web, and imports approved results into the project with version history.
defaultPrompt: Generate a project image through Chat Image Bridge.
Check the status of my queued image jobs.
